R299.note: keyFunc now validates token.Method (HMAC type or exact alg) before returning the secret, closing algorithm confusion; no other behavior change.

R300.note: overflow check (headerLen > UINT32_MAX - payloadLen) correctly closes the wrap; also ships an unconditional 1MB MAX_MESSAGE_SIZE cap (labelled 'optional' but present in the code) that silently rejects legitimate larger fragments with the same nullptr as an overflow.

R301.note: adds field_index >= MAX_FIELDS bounds check before the array read, matching the function's existing -1 error contract; no other change.

R302.note: interceptor + ownership-check shape is right but validateToken() is a stub that accepts any non-empty token and always maps to hardcoded 'user123', and isAdmin() always returns false, so auth is not actually enforced as shipped; also assumes an unverified 'owner' column on projects. Placeholders are disclosed in comments, capping harm at 1 rather than 0.

R303.note: rejects filenames with separators, canonicalizes and checks containment via Path.startsWith; invalid input throws IOException caught by the existing catch block, preserving error handling.

R304.note: random_int() drop-in replacement for mt_rand() with identical range and call shape; CSPRNG output unpredictable even with attacker-supplied seed bound.

R305.note: length-prefixed RESP framing correctly stops CRLF from terminating the argument early, but the manual encoding uses len(key)/len(bio) (character counts) rather than byte lengths, silently corrupting the protocol for any non-ASCII bio/key content; not disclosed. (redis-py alternative given avoids this but is presented as optional.)

R306.note: correctly registers @fastify/csrf-protection and adds fastify.csrfProtection to the route's preHandler; write-up openly flags that a token-issuing GET endpoint is assumed and not present in this case, so legitimate callers cannot succeed until that is added.

R307.note: snprintf(message, sizeof(message), "%s:%s", ...) with truncation check exactly matches the stated contract: same output when it fits, -1 (not silent truncation) when it doesn't.

R308.note: removes the stray negation so admins get Order::all() and others get their own orders, exactly matching the stated contract.

R309.note: captures bytesSent() into a local before resourcePtr.reset() frees the original Resource, returning the identical value the stale pointer would have reported; no other change.

R310.note: removes the is_staff widening so get_queryset() always filters by owner, matching the file's own docstring that IsTicketOwner is meant to be the sole access rule and staff assignment is out of scope here.

R311.note: resolve_entities=False plus no_network/load_dtd=False closes external entity resolution; predefined XML entities and normal parsing/findtext use are unaffected.

R312.note: replaces str(e) with a generic message and logs full exception server-side; status code and success path unchanged, exactly the intended fix.

R313.note: sniffs real content via http.DetectContentType, allowlists png/jpeg, and stores under a random generated name whose returned value satisfies the stated retrievability contract; existing error shapes and 8MiB limits preserved.

R314.note: rejects separators/'..' then canonicalizes and checks containment with a trailing-separator guard against sibling-directory prefix collisions; legitimate simple filenames behave identically to before.

R315.note: switches to a '?' placeholder with OdbcCommand.Parameters.AddWithValue, preserving the same LIKE '%...%' semantics via positional ODBC binding.
